hypotheses.statement: Abort checks after every awaited boundary plus no-resurrection checkpoint semantics prevent discarded jobs from reserving or executing.
hypotheses.mechanism: Own one AbortController per running account or DM job, abort on discard, recheck current job identity before checkpoint and reservation, finalize any post-reservation abort as canceled, and reject checkpoint writes for missing jobs.

hypotheses.falsifier: Reservation, driver execution, or job resurrection remains observable after abort/discard.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Apply the cancellation model to both account and DM flows before any visual refinement is published.
